variables.input:
fetch events, scanLimitGBytes:10
| filter event.kind == "DAVIS_PROBLEM"
| expand entity_tags
| filter contains(entity_tags, "ALTCI") OR contains(entity_tags, "ACRONYM")
| summarize tags = collectDistinct(entity_tags)
| fields tags
//| limit 200

1.content: ### Which types of issues happen most frequently?

3.title: Problems by Category
3.query:
fetch events
| filter event.kind == "DAVIS_PROBLEM" AND dt.davis.is_duplicate == false
| expand entity_tags
| filter in(entity_tags, $Tag)
| summarize {problemCount = countDistinct(event.id), by:{event.category}}
| sort problemCount desc

4.content: ### How long does it take us to resolve issues?

5.title: Top 20 Problems by Event
5.query:
fetch events
| filter event.kind == "DAVIS_PROBLEM" AND dt.davis.is_duplicate == false 
| expand entity_tags
| filter in(entity_tags, $Tag)
| summarize {problemCount = countDistinct(event.id), by:{event.name}}
| sort problemCount desc
| limit 20

//remove

6.title: Median Problem resolution Time
6.query:
fetch events
| filter event.kind == "DAVIS_PROBLEM" AND dt.davis.is_duplicate == false 
| expand entity_tags
| filter in(entity_tags, $Tag)
| summarize minutes_to_resolve=median(toDouble(resolved_problem_duration)/60000), by:{bin(timestamp, 1m)}
| fieldsAdd  minutes_to_resolve, alias: `Median Minutes to Resolve`
| fieldsRemove minutes_to_resolve

7.title: Median Problem Resolution Time in Minutes

10.title: Median Problem Resolution Time by Event Category in Minutes
10.query:
fetch events
| filter event.kind == "DAVIS_PROBLEM" AND dt.davis.is_duplicate == false 
| expand entity_tags
| filter in(entity_tags, $Tag)
| filter isNotNull(resolved_problem_duration)
| summarize minutes_to_resolve=median(toDouble(resolved_problem_duration)/60000), by:{event.category}
| summarize median(minutes_to_resolve), alias:`MTTR`, by:{event.category}
| sort MTTR desc

12.title: Most common Slowdown & Error root causes
12.query:
fetch events
| filter event.kind == "DAVIS_PROBLEM" AND (event.category == "SLOWDOWN" OR event.category == "ERROR") AND dt.davis.is_duplicate == false
| filterOUT isNull(root_cause_entity_id)
| expand entity_tags
| filter in(entity_tags, $Tag)
| summarize count = countDistinct(event.id), by:{root_cause_entity_id}
| sort count desc

30.query:
fetch events
| filter event.kind == "DAVIS_EVENT"
AND event.status == "ACTIVE"
AND isNotNull(dt.entity.host)
| expand entity_tags
| filter in(entity_tags, $Tag)
| summarize problemcount = count(), by:{bin(timestamp, 1d), dt.entity.host, dt.entity.host.name, event.category}
| sort problemcount desc
| fieldsAdd status = if(problemcount > 20, "🔴", else: if(problemcount > 10, "🟡", else: if(problemcount >= 0, "🟢")))
| filter event.category == "RESOURCE_CONTENTION"
| filter status != "🟢"
| fieldsRename value = `problemcount`

31.query:
fetch events, from:now()-30d
| filter event.kind == "DAVIS_PROBLEM" AND dt.davis.is_duplicate == false 
| expand entity_tags
| filter in(entity_tags, $Tag)
| summarize medianMTTR = median(resolved_problem_duration), by:{bin(timestamp, 1h)}
| fieldsAdd  medianMTTR, alias: `Median Minutes to Resolve`
| fieldsRemove medianMTTR
